d.t: HIGH-RANGE WATER REDUCING CONCRETE ADMIXTURE WITH WORKABILITY RETAINING TECHNOLOGY
d.s: Sika ViscoCrete-88 SC is a liquid high-range water reducing and workability retaining admixture for concrete and shotcrete that requires extended workability.
a: Less sensitive to variations in cement and aggregate types
us: Applications that require high quality concrete
Applications that require improved workability retention
d.pk: 10 litre container 1000 litre IBC bulk deliveries

sec.t: Sika ViscoCrete-88 SC meets the requirements of AS1478.1 (type HWR).
12 months from date of production if stored properly in undamaged containers.
Store in dry conditions at temperatures between +5°C and +35°C. Protect from direct sunlight and frost.

Sika ViscoCrete-88 SC should be dispensed through suitable calibrated dosing equipment with the mixing water The standard rules of good concreting practice, concerning production as well as placing, are to be followed. Refer to relevant standards. Sika ViscoCrete-88 SC should not be added to dry cement .

Sika ViscoCrete-88 SC can be used in conjunction with all the concrete admixtures manufactured by Sika Australia PTY Limited with the exclusion of Sikament NN. All admixtures must be added separately. For additional information, please contact Sika technical personnel.
Recommended dosage for concrete: 400 ml to 1500 ml per 100 kg of total cementitious material. Optimum dosage should be determined by site trials.
